sources.title: Gemini Generate Content API image understanding
sources.claim: GenerateContent supports multiple image Parts. Existing KeepBoard single-image restriction is application-specific.
sources.limit: API capability does not establish object correspondence or quality; no authentication or calls performed.

sources.title: SAHI paper and official sliced inference
sources.claim: Overlapping slices, coordinate recovery and detection merging; optional full-image context.
sources.limit: Aerial object detection benchmarks do not measure VLM game attributes, ownership or restoration.

sources.title: UReader
sources.access: LANDING_OPENED; PDF details reused from prior cited research
sources.claim: Shape-adaptive crops in a trained OCR-free multimodal document model.
sources.limit: Internal trained tiling is different from independent parallel API requests; no KeepBoard transfer measurement.

sources.title: Grounding DINO
sources.claim: Image plus text produces object boxes and phrase similarities.
sources.limit: Printed values and exact boardgame identities are not guaranteed; no new endpoint or runtime tested.

sources.title: OWL-ViT official implementation
sources.claim: Text-conditioned and one-shot image-conditioned detection are implemented.
sources.limit: Reference similarity is not exact identity, ownership, current count or same-instance tracking.

sources.title: V*: Guided Visual Search
sources.claim: Targeted visual search addresses detailed questions in high-resolution crowded scenes.
sources.limit: Question-focused search is not exhaustive inventory; iterative calls can add latency. CVF page returned 403; arXiv and author repository used without bypass.

sources.title: OpenCV homography theory and implementation examples
sources.claim: Homography maps planes with a projective transform.
sources.limit: Non-planar elevated pieces, moved objects and ambiguous repeated patterns need separate handling; source mapping does not fix perception errors.

sources.title: MTG Card Scanner
sources.claim: Author describes contour/perspective correction, pHash/ORB artwork matching to a limited reference set and user review.
sources.limit: Implementation behavior and accuracy not independently executed or source-verified. No claim this is a validated general board scanner; no asset/code reuse licensing claim.

sources.title: Gemini API rate limits
sources.claim: Project request/token limits apply to concurrent calls too.
sources.limit: Current account limits not queried. Parallel wall-time reduction does not imply token reduction.

claims.statement: Current scoped Gemini scan path selects last image and hosted task compiler accepts exactly one.
Catan public board uses native scene/slot prompt; generic hosted reading is literal.
Existing frame and atlas mapping are Catan-specific; geometryCandidates covers terrain/number-token/robber, not general inter-photo registration.
Reference set input and nonempty reference candidates are currently rejected.
Current definition index contains 120 games; this is schema coverage only.
2026-10-24 preflight reports 0 verified complete printed-identity reference catalogs and 437 display-art classes. Current corpus completeness was not reaudited.
Recent four-crop run: parallel 25.796 seconds, total13034 tokens, 90 raw rows to55 physical candidate groups after human review. Not a measured automatic merger or overall accuracy.
Reuse existing API and definitions; anchor photo plus bounded supplemental observations, with literal facts separate from geometric/identity links and accepted state.
Use confirmed topology immediately; add optional edition-specific real exemplars only where confusion persists. Defer detector-first and automatic multiview tracking as prerequisites.
Actual multi-view correspondence, reference benefit, optimal crop overlap/concurrency, full capture-to-save effort and deployed/shared parity are not measured here.

decision.priority: Existing API, anchor plus supplemental observation, deterministic mapping when supported and explicit review
